description: Pay-per-call website checks, web fetch and data tools for AI agents (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: try_free
tools.description: Free, no wallet needed. Runs one of the 52 paid tools priced up to $0.005 on your input and returns its real answer. 3 free calls per IP per UTC day; failed calls do not count. Example: {"tool":"page_markdown","arguments":{"url":"https://example.com"}}

tools.name: site_report
tools.description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). One call: a client-ready, evidence-backed website audit and remediation plan (SEO on up to 10 pages, passive security, links, email authentication, AI readiness). Every finding has evidence, observed/inferred basis, priority, effort, a concrete fix and how to verify it; plus a phased implementation plan, what needs human review, and an honest coverage section. JSON + Markdown + self-contained HTML, optional white-label branding. Passive, point-in-time; not a penetration test. Returns the finished site-report/1 or status "running" with result_url / delivery_id + key to poll (free tool site_report_status). Bad input is refused before payment; a report where every check fails before it is accepted is not charged; once accepted (202) it is charged and a later failure is not refunded automatically. If a paid job failed, email hello@lordevo.com with the transaction hash and we'll review it, usually within 2 business days.

tools.name: site_check

Returns overall risk level and scores, top fixes and the three full sub-results. Method and error rates: https://shop.lordevo.com/docs/trust-methodology
